findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

(REPEAT) Observed both customer hand sinks to lack caulk. Discussed caulking with PIC in order to have area be smooth and easily cleanable. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 2/14/20.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on bottom shelving of all cold hold units. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.

Observed all cold holding units to have debris at bottom shelving. Discussed routine cleaning of coolers with PIC.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16  (C) Mop was found stored incorrectly in-between use. Mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.  Reference 6-501.16.

Observed mop to not be hanging in a manner that allows to drip dry and/or air dry in between uses. Discussed proper procedure with PIC. COS.
